'''Kalishik''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kalishik system/Legends|Kalishik system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda]] and [[Feena system/Legends|Feena systems]]. Kalishik was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[T'sarki]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and had a modest industrial base.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalishik was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
